security_audit.summary: No malicious intent, prompt injection, data exfiltration, credential access, or destructive behavior was found. The static findings are false positives from Jest documentation, placeholder relative imports, MSW mock handlers, and a read-only setup checker script. The Bash helper should still be treated as optional and reviewed before execution in untrusted projects.

remediation.issue: Optional Bash helper can look risky to automated scanners.
remediation.suggestion: Document that the setup checker is optional, read-only, and uses hardcoded commands. Keep it free of user-controlled shell arguments.

remediation.issue: Template files contain placeholder relative imports that resemble traversal patterns.
remediation.suggestion: Label template imports clearly as placeholders and keep examples scoped to test files.

content.value_statement: Jest projects often need consistent setup, mocking, and assertion patterns. This skill gives focused guidance, templates, and checks for JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and Vitest-style tests.
actual_capabilities: Explains Jest configuration for environments, transforms, module aliases, and coverage thresholds.
Provides examples for matchers, mock functions, module mocks, timers, snapshots, and async assertions.
Guides React Testing Library usage, including queries, user events, component tests, and hook tests.
Shows MSW patterns for mocking API success, error, and network failure scenarios.
Includes a reusable TypeScript test template for units, classes, dependencies, components, and hooks.
Includes an optional setup checker script for Jest dependencies, config files, test files, scripts, and CI hints.
limitations: It focuses on Jest and Vitest-compatible APIs, not every test runner or browser automation framework.
The examples are templates and must be adapted to each project structure and dependency version.
The setup checker inspects files and package names, but it does not prove that tests pass.
It does not replace a full security review or a separate test quality audit.

use_cases.title: Set Up Jest in a Project
use_cases.description: Configure Jest, TypeScript transforms, setup files, coverage thresholds, and package scripts for a new codebase.

use_cases.title: Repair Failing Test Patterns
use_cases.description: Choose better matchers, async assertions, timer controls, and mocks when existing Jest tests are flaky or unclear.
use_cases.target_user: Maintainer of an existing JavaScript project

use_cases.title: Test React User Flows
use_cases.description: Create React Testing Library tests that use accessible queries, user-event interactions, hooks, and MSW-backed API mocks.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Jest Test
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a focused unit test.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me write a Jest unit test for this function. Explain the arrange, act, and assert steps in simple terms.

prompt_templates.title: Add Mocks and Async Assertions
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for dependencies and promises.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Jest test and improve its mocks, async assertions, and cleanup. Keep the test behavior the same.

prompt_templates.title: Configure Jest for TypeScript and React
prompt_templates.scenario: Project setup request with React Testing Library.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me configure Jest for a TypeScript React project with React Testing Library, jest-dom, setup files, and coverage thresholds.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Complete Test Strategy
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request across configuration, mocks, and CI.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this Jest test suite and propose a test strategy for coverage, MSW API mocks, flaky async tests, CI behavior, and long-term maintainability.

output_examples.input: A developer asks how to test a function that throws validation errors.
output_examples.output: The skill would suggest separate tests for valid input, invalid input, expected error type, and boundary values.

output_examples.input: A React component loads data and shows an error state.
output_examples.output: The skill would outline a test using accessible queries, user-event actions, wait helpers, and MSW handlers for success and failure paths.

output_examples.input: A project has Jest installed but inconsistent configuration.
output_examples.output: The skill would check dependencies, setup files, test scripts, coverage settings, and CI test workflow gaps.

best_practices: Prefer accessible Testing Library queries before test IDs.
Reset mocks, timers, and server handlers between tests.
Cover success, error, loading, and boundary paths with clear assertions.
anti_patterns: Do not test implementation details that users cannot observe.
Do not leave shared mutable state across tests.
Do not use snapshots as the only assertion for important behavior.

faq.question: Can this skill help with Vitest?
faq.answer: Yes. Many examples apply to Vitest because its testing API is similar to Jest.

faq.question: Does it run my tests automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and an optional setup checker, but test execution remains under user control.

faq.question: Can it generate React Testing Library tests?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes patterns for accessible queries, user-event interactions, component rendering, hooks, and async UI states.

faq.question: Does it support network request tests?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents MSW patterns for mocking API responses without making real network requests.

faq.question: Will the templates match my project exactly?
faq.answer: No. The templates use placeholder imports and example names that must be adapted to your codebase.

faq.question: Is this a general test quality reviewer?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on Jest-specific setup, APIs, and patterns rather than broad quality analysis.
